draft.subject: One small step for Summit Dynamics
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project is usually the step that makes everything else click. If it helps, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you, or just answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
